name: Backwork
description: Medicare and commercial payer policies, prior auth checks, claim risk and medical code lookup with cited sources, from the Backwork API. Requires a Backwork account and API key.
author: Backwork LLC

BACKWORK_API_KEY.description: Backwork live API key (bwk_live_...), created in the Backwork app under API Keys.

BACKWORK_API_BASE.description: Override the Backwork API base URL, for example https://backworkhealth.com/api/sandbox/v1 for a bwk_test_ key. Defaults to https://backworkhealth.com/api/v1.
